title: Distinct per-guild occupant silhouettes (C-029)
simLoop: No sim change — OccupantMesh is presentation-only (T-006). Six new procedural geometries (src/render/guildGeometry.ts) replace the single shared cone; dominant-guild selection, biomass-driven scale, sway, and tint are unchanged. Bonus fix: occupant vitality now reads each guild's own veg.hsi.* (available since §4.48) instead of herb's habitat.suitability for every guild.
gameLoop: Six vegetation guilds now read as six different life-forms on sight — herb tuft, strand mound, binder tussock, marsh reeds, shrub's branching form, crust's flat patch — not one shape in six colors.
notebookSeed: Six different shapes are growing here now, not six colors of the same blade — a reed isn't a tussock isn't a shrub.
tierO: no owner-only question — geometric distinctness is CI-judged (guildGeometry.test.ts asserts every pair of silhouettes clears an aspect-ratio floor, the geometric analogue of colorDistance); D-007 clip gate does not apply (no new Process, presentation only).
